name: Jumbo Bag Limited
summary: Jumbo Bag Ltd. engages in the production and sale of flexible intermediate bulk container packaging materials for industrial purposes. It operates through the Manufacturing and Trading segments. The Manufacturing segment produces flexible intermediate bulk container packaging material. The Trading segment markets and sells polypropylene granules which are used in the manufacture of plastics. The company was founded on November 29, 1990 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
